name: Zip-Codes.com ZIP & Postal Code MCP
description: Location intelligence for US addresses and ZIP Codes: standardize a US street address to its ZIP+4, look up US ZIP Codes and Canadian postal codes, search by radius, measure distance and request census tract demographics and district overlaps. Listed without a key, the endpoint runs in demo mode: real values, with deeper fields withheld except on demo codes and addresses. An X-Api-Key header with a free key (2,500 credits a day) removes the masking.
author: Zip-Codes.com
